description: This file defines a class 'Neo4jWriter' that provides methods to connect to a Neo4j database and perform write operations for articles and chunks, including schema setup and merging nodes with relationships. It includes internal functions for hashing chunk identifiers and manages embeddings storage as an optional feature. The class is designed to facilitate idempotent, schema-aware writes for an application involving articles and textual chunks with embeddings.

classes.name: Neo4jWriter
classes.description: A wrapper class for Neo4j database write operations, supporting schema setup, merging articles and chunks, and managing connection lifecycles.

methods.name: str _hash_chunk_id(article_title: str, index: int, text: str)
methods.description: Generates a SHA-256 hash based on article title, chunk index, and a snippet of the text to produce a unique chunk ID.

methods.name: __init__(self, uri: Optional[str] = None, user: Optional[str] = None, password: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Initializes the Neo4jWriter with optional connection parameters; retrieves default credentials from environment if not provided.

methods.name: Driver _get_driver(self)
methods.description: Lazily creates and returns a Neo4j driver instance for database connections.

methods.name: close(self)
methods.description: Closes the current Neo4j driver connection, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: _ensure_schema(self, session: Session)
methods.description: Creates necessary constraints and indexes in the database if they do not already exist.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] write_article_with_chunks( self, title: str, url: str, chunks: Sequence[Dict[str, object]], embeddings: Optional[Sequence[Sequence[float]]] = None, store_embeddings: bool = True, )
methods.description: Main public method that merges an article node along with its associated chunk nodes and relationships, optionally storing embeddings.
